Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Nikhil - 8 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Anjali - 42 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Ananya - 9 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
4. Vimla - 74 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses
5. Zoya - 10 years, friend
Look: glasses, blue dress

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Nikhil stands in the courtyard. Anjali, Ananya and Vimla stand near him.]

Vimla: "Today feels like a good day."

[Nikhil bursts out laughing.]

Nikhil: "What happened?"

[Nikhil starts crying.]

Anjali: "Ananya, are you okay?"

[Nikhil smiles at Mother.]

Vimla: "Careful!"

[Nikhil stamps his foot in anger.]

Nikhil: "And then?"

[Nikhil gets frightened and steps back.]

Nikhil: "I'm ready!"

Scene 2: The road - Day

[Nikhil stands by the road. Anjali and Ananya stand near him.]

Nikhil: "Ananya, look over here."

[Nikhil rides his bicycle down the road.]

Ananya (happily): "Yes, all right."

[Nikhil gets into the car.]

Nikhil: "One more time!"

[Nikhil gets off the school bus.]

Ananya: "That was such a fun day!"
